use default

use DATE = (month: string, day: int)

sharing_the_day(dates: List[DATE], day: int) -> int =>
    dates |> filter(date => date.day == day) |> count()

sharing_the_month(dates: List[DATE], month: string) -> int =>
    dates |> filter(date => date.month =~ month) |> count()

let possible = [
    (month = "May", day = 15), (month = "May", day = 16),
    (month = "May", day = 19), (month = "June", day = 17),
    (month = "June", day = 18), (month = "July", day = 14),
    (month = "July", day = 16), (month = "August", day = 14),
    (month = "August", day = 15), (month = "August", day = 17)]

let albert_knows_bernard_does_not = possible
    |> filter(date =>
        possible
            |> filter(other => other.month =~ date.month)
            |> all(other => sharing_the_day(possible, other.day) > 1))
    |> collect()

let bernard_now_knows = albert_knows_bernard_does_not
    |> filter(date =>
        sharing_the_day(albert_knows_bernard_does_not, date.day) == 1)
    |> collect()

let birthday = bernard_now_knows
    |> filter(date =>
        sharing_the_month(bernard_now_knows, date.month) == 1)
    |> only()

write_line("Cheryl's birthday is {birthday.month} {birthday.day}")
